description: Focus on the real cost of keeping a domain: its annual renewal price. Compare selected registrars, with initial registration prices shown separately and supported multi-year estimates. Your assistant suggests names and checks availability and premium status. Preserve source dates, partial coverage and unknown results. Renewal rates can change; purchases and exact premium prices remain at the registrar. Optional Cloudflare Radar data measures DNS popularity, not Google search competition. The native form collects seed names and an optional project brief; your current assistant generates and checks suggestions. The website form prepares a request to copy into a connected assistant. Website subscription authentication is not implemented.

defaultPrompt: Show three extensions renewing under $15/year, with registrar, initial price and source date. Do not check availability.
Suggest eight names for my project under $15/year renewal. Check availability and premium status; explain any shortfall.
Compare .com renewal prices, registration and five-year estimates across covered registrars, with source dates.
